text:
emma: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the multi-canary GPU OOMs. We need owners and tickets for the three remediation tracks: runtime leak, canary gating, and monitoring/alerts. Goal: owners assigned by EOD Friday (3/27).
raj: I will own the runtime leak investigation. Creating the ticket now.
cole: I can take canary gating + rollout playbook (including canary pass/fail criteria).
marie: I'll be Accountable for closure — please keep me looped. RACI sketch: R=Raj, A=Marie, C=Cole, I=Emma + SRE.
oncall-bot: Added label `postmortem-action` and pinged the SRE rotation group.
sre-rotations-bot: Noted. Next oncall will assist repro + alert tuning during the investigation window.
emma: Please include ETA estimates, PR checklists, and link runbooks in each ticket. Also set `priority: P1` for the runtime leak.
raj: Created REDWOOD-4521: runtime-leak-investigation — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4521. ETA: prototype patch by 2026-03-30. Labels: postmortem-action, priority-P1.
cole: Created REDWOOD-4522: canary-gating-playbook — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4522. ETA: playbook draft + tests by 2026-04-03. I'll add the test matrix and rollback steps.
ben: Created REDWOOD-4523: monitoring-and-alerting-tune — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4523. Will add alert thresholds and dashboard panels.
marie: I set a recurring weekly check-in (Thursdays 10:00 PT) for postmortem follow-ups. Emma, can you invite the group?
emma: Invite sent to @raj @cole @marie @ben and infra-owners. Calendar event includes links to the three tickets.
raj: FYI I'll need SRE help to reproduce the steady memory growth — tagging @ben and @sre-rotations-bot in the REDWOOD-4521 comment with logs.
cole: I'll draft the rollback playbook and a safe-fallback policy for model routing. Will link PR to REDWOOD-4522 when ready.
marie: RACI doc snippet for the record:
```
Runtime leak: R=Raj, A=Marie, C=Ben (SRE), I=Emma
Canary gating: R=Cole, A=Marie, C=Raj, I=Emma
Monitoring: R=Ben (SRE), A=Marie, C=Raj/Cole, I=Emma
```
emma: Confirmed. Closure criteria: all three tickets have PRs merged, canary stable for 48h after gating, and a follow-up doc published. If no blockers, target to close loop by 2026-04-10.
raj: :thumbsup: I'll update REDWOOD-4521 with repro steps by EOD tomorrow.
cole: Will start the playbook draft today and add acceptance tests to REDWOOD-4522.
ben: I'll add tuned alerts and a dashboard snapshot to REDWOOD-4523 by 3/29.
emma: Thanks — I'll mark action owners in the postmortem doc and start the RACI handoff checklist. Ping here if timelines slip.
